title: Daylight spine ledger
summary: Interior pages open on a 640px band of the daylight film with hero B's own nav bar (lockup, tracked caps with '+', the current section underlined, outlined AUDIT REQUEST ↗) and the hero stack in ink at the lower left: red-square label, a 92px title ending in the light, muted 'hears.', the red rule, a two-line lede and both doors; an engagement ledger hangs off a hairline at the bottom right. The Index Spine is reborn at the film's edge and the page hangs from it: 01 Overview (sentence + light muted sentence, red rule, one paragraph, the three capabilities stepped like the mark), then 02 Manifest as a ledger that opens in place.

reference.borrowed: YLLW's three-track services page: a narrow left column holding only a small label, a large statement with a short lede under it in the middle track, then a full-width stack of hairline rows. Each row has a small descriptor, the service name set large, and a '+' toggle at the right margin, with generous vertical padding.
reference.kelwin: YLLW's label column becomes B's Index Spine column: a 1px vertical at the col 3|4 gutter that resumes at the film's bottom edge, a right-angle opening rule with the 6px joint square, light 64px indices ('01', '02'), and the hero's red-square caps labels ('OVERVIEW', 'MANIFEST'). The caps statement becomes an 88px sentence plus a light muted sentence, with the short red rule under it. The overview's side note, 'One architecture', reads the mark's step as typography: C·01 (this page), then C·02 and C·03, each nested one 24px step in and hung from the row above by a hairline corner. YLLW's descriptor moves out of the spine into cols 9–11 as each service's artifact, and the '+' is drawn from two 1px lines that rotate to '−'. Exactly one row is open: S·01 shows its scope and the matching line from the six-week install. The header is the daylight film reprise at a closer crop than the hero (feathered into the paper ground), carrying the founder's low-left stack, with tracked-caps doors and a hairline engagement ledger in cols 10–12. There is no red text. The reds are the label squares, the two short rules and the primary button.

motion: entrance (header): the glass starts as full milk and settles over 1.2s. The label fades, the title lines rise 12px (the light 'hears.' lands about 200ms behind), the red rule draws, the lede and doors rise, the engagement hairline draws down, and its row rules draw out at a 60ms stagger.

entrance (spine, from about 0.8s): the joint square appears at the film's edge, the opening rule draws from the spine to the right margin (900ms), and the spine draws down the page (1.4s). '01 ■ OVERVIEW' fades in (400ms), the statement rises with the muted sentence 160ms behind, the red rule draws, then the paragraph and the stepped 'One architecture' note follow.

entrance (ledger): 02's opening rule draws from the spine (900ms), and the row rules draw top-down at a 60ms stagger as their text fades in. The ledger arrives closed, then S·01 opens in place at about 2.1s (height and opacity, 360ms --ease-inout) and its '+' rotates to '−'. That open row is the resting state.
ambient: only the daylight film, slowed to a 48s drift, with a silhouette crossing about every 30s and the frosted grain.

interaction: rows open and close in place, one at a time. A hovered row fills --panel from the spine to the margin and its title shifts 8px right. The C·02 and C·03 links and 'TALK TO THE TEAM' underline from the left (300ms). On the primary, the fill deepens and ↗ moves 2px up-right.
on the live site: the spine index is sticky and crossfades from 01 to 02 (300ms) as the manifest passes. prefers-reduced-motion shows the final state with S·01 open.
notes: Interior page header and first body beat, cropped to 1400px (the manifest shows S·01 open and S·02). Coherence pass: the header had nav clearance but no nav — the bar is now drawn, identical to the hero's; the header takes the hero's exact stack (92px title, 36/40/28/36px gaps) and grows from 560 to 640px so the label clears the bar; the film uses the hero's calibration (blur 10px, frost 22%, brightness 1.02, saturation .7, grain .42) with the plate lowered so the figure's head and shoulders sit right of the title; body offsets match the shared 48px. Interior numbering restarts at 01 because it is a separate page; capability codes (C·01) match the nav and footer.
